paragraphs.text: Rain remains in Pontotoc County’s Sunday forecast, with another round expected Tuesday night. The National Weather Service’s 9:06 a.m. CST forecast for Nov. 1 calls for showers likely late Sunday morning, followed by a chance of afternoon showers. The rain chance for the rest of Sunday is 70 percent, with highs in the upper 60s.

The county forecast lowers the shower chance to 20 percent Sunday night, with lows in the upper 50s. Monday is expected to be mostly cloudy with highs in the mid 70s; the NWS morning discussion describes a brief break from the rain.

Rain chances increase again after Monday. Tuesday has a 20 percent chance of afternoon showers, rising to 90 percent Tuesday night with showers and a chance of thunderstorms. Wednesday’s rain chance is 70 percent. These figures come from the Pontotoc County section of the dated forecast linked below.
